forum.content_text:
Here:

In the ‘Best Answer’ shown at the top of the thread (immediately after the OP), it’s on a black background:

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/e49d3b98-9e9a-4af6-86b2-fe0c08df9681.png)

But, in its original position within the thread view, it’s on a grey background:

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/f0ce0ee5-0e65-4d23-826a-eb3d7cf8c521.png)

Note also that the line spacing is different - so the “ASCII Art” no longer works properly
